title: In motion: how much of the airborne rock should a blast take?
question: Which one do you want to play with -- and is the middle one leaving enough to go back and smash?
context_md:
Animated, since the stills could not answer this. Same five charges, same seed, only how much stranded rock the finished blast sweeps up.

You said you were *"trying to decide if I like this best or want all the hunks in the air gone -- I could see it being fun smashing the leftover pieces."* This is that question as three settings of one number (`chip_sweep_cells`, in the menu under `cracks`), so you can pick rather than describe.

**0** is what you photographed. **6** is what I have landed -- it takes only fragments below the size the fragmenter itself will touch, so dust goes and anything worth hitting stays. **24** takes essentially every loose piece in the air, the "all the hunks gone" end.

Whatever you pick is one integer, changeable live.

items.label: 0 -- nothing swept (what you saw)
items.caption: chips left exactly where the blast stranded them

items.label: 6 -- dust only (landed default)
items.caption: below the fragmenter's own floor; smashable clumps survive

items.label: 24 -- take the hunks too
items.caption: the 'all the hunks in the air gone' end
